notes.title: UPDATE 1.15
notes.content:
[h2]Collison[/h2]
- Last Collison fix causes some issues in multiplayer. Concluded to remove player collision all together. Now players will no longer collide with each other fixing many issues,

notes.title: UPDATE 1.1
notes.content:
[h2]Achievements[/h2]
- Can now get achievements from completing game objectives and milestones.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
- Fixed player collision being to small allowing player to see through walls. 
- Adjusted item collision so player no longer bugs out if standing on top of a item causing the player to spin.
- Fixed some audio not replicating properly.

[h2]Behavior[/h2]
- Minor adjustments to Mothman's behavior, you are no longer safe in the RV.

[h2]Tooltip[/h2]
- Explicitly mention the server will not be listening once you start the game (you are now told the server will be closed upon starting)
